name: dcc
description: Kerchanshe Group Digital Communications Control Center (DCC)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dcc/contracts && npm run build -w @dcc/engine-client && npm run build -w @dcc/backend && npm run build -w @dcc/frontend
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @dcc/contracts && npm run build -w @dcc/engine-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dcc/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/engine-client && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/backend && npm run typecheck -w @dcc/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dcc/contracts && npm run test -w @dcc/engine-client && npm run test -w @dcc/backend
scripts.db:reset: node scripts/db/bootstrap.mjs --reset && npm run db:migrate -w @dcc/backend && npm run db:seed -w @dcc/backend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:packages && npm run infra:up && npm run db:bootstrap && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.mirror:db: node scripts/run-with-env.mjs .env.mirror node scripts/db/bootstrap.mjs && node scripts/run-with-env.mjs .env.mirror npm run db:migrate -w @dcc/backend
scripts.build:mirror: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @dcc/backend && npm run build:mirror -w @dcc/frontend
